snippet.description:

snippet.title: Terror Time D&D: Ep. 1 FRIEND PARTY【Animated Curse of Strahd Campaign】
snippet.description:
Watch Episode 2! https://youtu.be/-DuooEiWC_8

Want to support our content? Become a member of our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/vibecheckdnd/

Terror Time is a visual novel style podcast playing the Curse of Strahd module. As our TikTok animatics/skits grew in popularity, you guys began expressing interest in listening to the full sessions. Luckily, we have our whole campaign recorded! We're made up of a group of friends who came together to play D&D for fun and are NOT professionals; we're just fans of the game and like to roleplay and draw our silly little fantasy characters. This campaign is currently in-progress, now running for over two years.

Terror Time will also be available in podcast form on Spotify! You can find us here: https://open.spotify.com/show/0JSdkhC2hZwflvucRd5bfV?si=f9ea1132c2544fbe

snippet.title: Terror Time D&D: The Braid Debate 【Curse of Strahd Animatic】
snippet.description:
This is an animatic of a moment from one of our DND sessions! We figured this would be a good scene to show a little bit of our party's dynamic lol. 

We are a group of friends playing a Curse of Strahd campaign, and we had recorded our DND sessions in case we wanted to make animatics of certain scenes. We had no intentions of posting the full sessions anywhere online, until there was an unexpected level of interest on TikTok.
So now we're currently in the process of editing the first few episodes of our upcoming passion project: Terror Time D&D! It will be in the style of a visual novel, everything illustrated/animated by our own players!

To see more of our existing content and any future updates, subscribe to our YouTube channel, or visit OllieTheDuke on TikTok!
https://www.tiktok.com/@ollietheduke?
